card.title: Nintendo Switch Not turning on, draws 200mA at 15V Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Not turning on, draws 200mA at 15V Repair

symptoms: drops to 0.1 A when held off

claims.statement: Switch drawing 0.2 A at 15 V that drops to 0.1 A when 'turned off' with the power button (and rises again when turned on) can be caused by PI3USB; replace it.

measurements.context: At 15 V; 0.1 A when held off
